decisions.reason: The DCDC1 change applies when the power board is attached; standalone USB regulation applies when that board is disconnected, and its 3.3V rail and Schottky OR-ing behavior remain unchanged.
AXP2101 remains the normal-operation power source and still provides the required downstream 3.3V rail; the nominal DCDC1 setting is owned by the source Requirement.
The monitored downstream rail remains 3.3V after the Schottky diode, so the monitored rails and current-monitoring behavior do not change.
Changing DCDC1 voltage compensation does not alter the charge-status LED path, connector, resistor, or population requirements.
The same message independently introduces the panel power button, but the DCDC1 voltage decision does not change that button interface.
The source changes DCDC1 compensation for the downstream 3.3V rail and does not alter the MT3608-based switched 5V rail.
The DCDC1 output setting does not change the battery connector family, pin count, pin functions, access, or compatibility requirement.
The voltage-compensation decision does not change battery cutoff thresholds, thermal sensing, or protection behavior.
The three-board architecture and allocation of regulation and power-management roles remain unchanged.
The DCDC1 nominal output adjustment does not change ESP32 clocking, sleep policy, wake sources, or wake intervals.
The source explicitly preserves the downstream 3.3V rail, so interboard connector pin functions, topology, and power distribution remain unchanged.
The DCDC1 voltage setting does not affect the panel reset connector or its EN-to-GND action.
